name: Require authentication before app access
description: Verifies a signed-out visitor must authenticate before using Bishwa Search Engine.
steps: Open Bishwa in a signed-out browser session
Verify Continue with Google and email sign-in are visible
Verify search tools are not accessible before authentication succeeds
expected: A dedicated sign-in screen is shown and the search engine remains inaccessible until authentication succeeds.

name: Create a creator channel with an optimized custom logo
covers: custom channel logo upload to Supabase Storage
open uploaded channel logo in full-screen preview
description: Verifies an authenticated user can create a channel, upload an optimized logo with progress feedback, replace it and retain the latest logo.
steps: Sign in to Bishwa
Open the profile menu and choose My Channel
Enter a channel name, unique handle and category, then choose a JPG or PNG logo
Create the channel, replace its logo from the creator dashboard, and reload
expected: The channel dashboard shows the selected logo and retains the latest logo after reload; duplicate handles are rejected.

name: Publish photos and videos with upload progress
covers: resumable TUS image upload for files over 6 MB
resumable TUS video upload for files over 6 MB
description: Verifies the creator can publish allowed media and text content and sees the published items in the channel.
steps: Open an existing creator channel
Choose Image, select a photo and publish it
Verify the photo appears in Published content
Choose Video, upload an accepted video file, then publish a text post
Refresh the channel dashboard
expected: Published content appears in the channel after refresh, and video publishing is limited to the first four free videos until creator access is activated.

name: Block a fifth free video without blocking posts
covers: free image and text publishing remain available
description: Verifies the free video allowance is enforced while free image and text posts remain available.
setup: Create a channel and publish four video items
steps: Try to publish a fifth video without an active creator period
Verify the creator access message appears
Switch to Text post and publish a post
expected: The fifth video is not published, while the text post can still be published.

name: Discover a public channel and join its Super community
covers: automatic live feed updates after a creator publishes
open channel logos from the home feed
description: Verifies a second authenticated user can find a public channel, view its public content, subscribe and later unsubscribe.
setup: Actor A signs in and creates a public channel with a published post
Actor B signs in with a different account
steps: Actor B opens Public Channels from the home page or navigation menu
Search for Actor A's channel and open its public page
Tap Super and verify Super member state and count
Tap again to leave and verify the state changes back
Return Home and horizontally scroll categories below the search box
Scroll down through the large creator feed and verify the newest published media appears first
Tap a creator logo to open the enlarged logo preview
expected: The public channel and published items are visible to Actor B; Super membership updates the state and count, home categories scroll horizontally, and the home page shows a newest-first scrolling creator feed with expandable logos.

name: Filter category feeds and render map results
covers: Images category filters public photo uploads
Videos category filters public video uploads
News category shows public text posts
Maps category renders an embedded map for the current search
Maps occupies the full viewport on desktop and mobile
map controls remain accessible over the full-screen map
description: Verifies the existing category names open populated, type-specific content views without changing navigation labels.
steps: Publish one public image, one public video and one public text post from a creator channel
Open Images and verify only the photo appears
Open Videos and verify only the video appears
Open News and verify the text post appears
Open Maps and search for a place
expected: Each category shows the matching public content, Maps displays an interactive map edge-to-edge across the full viewport with floating Directions and Back controls, and the original category labels remain unchanged.

name: Delete a creator's published media
covers: delete control appears on own published content
deleted post disappears from the creator dashboard and public feed
description: Verifies only the channel owner can permanently delete a published post and its media object.
setup: Create a channel and publish a photo or video
steps: Open My Channel and locate the published item
Choose Delete and confirm the warning
Reload the creator dashboard and public feed
expected: The published post and its media are removed, and the item no longer appears after reload.

name: Track search and viewed content in account history
covers: viewed public video and post history
description: Verifies searches and opened or played public creator content appear in the signed-in user's durable activity history.
steps: Sign in as Actor A and search for a phrase
Open a public creator post and play a public video
Open History and verify the search, post and video activities with times and channel names
Refresh and verify the activities remain, then clear history
expected: History shows both searches and viewed content, retains the entries after refresh, and removes them after the user confirms Clear history.

name: Comment on a public post and delete your own comment
covers: comments load on public posts and videos
authenticated user can publish a comment
comment author name and timestamp display
comment owner can delete their own comment
other users cannot delete someone else's comment
description: Verifies authenticated comments are visible on public creator posts and that deletion is restricted to the comment author.
setup: Actor A publishes a public video or text post
Actor B signs in with a separate account
steps: Actor B opens Actor A's public post and expands Comments
Actor B writes and publishes a comment
Verify the comment appears with Actor B's name and time
Delete the comment as Actor B and verify it disappears
expected: The comment is visible to the viewer, can be deleted by its author, and the server rejects deletion attempts from another account.

name: Register devices and receive private chat notifications
description: Verifies each signed-in recipient can register their device and receive a push alert for a new private chat message.
setup: Actor A and Actor B sign in on separate devices
steps: Actor B opens Messages and taps Turn on notifications
Verify device registration succeeds
Actor A sends Actor B a private message
Put Actor B's browser in the background and verify the alert arrives
Tap the notification and verify Bishwa opens
expected: The recipient device is registered securely and receives a message notification while Bishwa is in the background; the sender sees whether push delivery was confirmed.

name: Show unread chat counts and share an image
covers: unread message count in recent chats
global unread message count badge beside the top navigation message icon
read marker clears unread count and removes the unread badge after the chat is opened
selected image preview and remove action
secure per-user Supabase chat image upload
image URL stored in Firebase Realtime Database chat message
description: Verifies new messages are visible in the chat list and users can send an image securely without using Firebase Storage.
setup: Actor A and Actor B have an existing private chat
steps: Actor A sends a message while Actor B is viewing another page
Verify Actor B sees an unread count beside the conversation
Actor B opens the chat and verify the unread count clears
Actor B attaches an image, previews it and sends it
Verify the image appears in the conversation on both devices
expected: Unread counts appear beside the recent chat and top navigation message icon, then disappear after the conversation is opened and marked as read; the selected photo is uploaded to the chat user's Supabase folder and appears as an image message in the shared Firebase chat.

name: Show the channel invitation on every app entry for channel owners
covers: delayed channel invitation after app entry
channel ownership lookup by signed-in Firebase user
close button dismisses invitation for current visit only
invitation appears again after next app entry
description: Verifies an authenticated channel owner sees the invitation after entering Bishwa, can dismiss it temporarily, and sees it again on the next app entry.
setup: Actor A signs in and owns an existing Bishwa channel
steps: Actor A opens Bishwa and waits for the channel invitation
Verify the invitation offers Open My Channel
Close the invitation using the X button
Reload Bishwa and wait for the invitation again
Choose Open My Channel and verify the creator dashboard opens
expected: The owner sees the channel invitation after each app entry, X hides it only for the current visit, and Open My Channel opens the existing creator dashboard.

name: Invite a signed-in viewer to create a channel
covers: channel absence lookup for signed-in user
channel creation page opens from invitation
description: Verifies a signed-in user without a channel receives a creation invitation and can dismiss it temporarily or continue to the channel form.
setup: Actor B signs in with an account that does not own a Bishwa channel
steps: Actor B opens Bishwa and waits for the channel invitation
Verify the invitation offers Create Your Channel
Close it with X, reload Bishwa and verify it appears again
Choose Create Your Channel and verify the channel creation form opens
expected: A user without a channel receives the creation invitation after each app entry, can dismiss it for the current visit, and can open the channel creation form.

name: Award Bishwa Verified through the owner-only BS option
covers: admin verification controls are hidden from non-admin accounts
admin user search is protected by Firebase token verification
DS and RSS do not award verification
BS awards Bishwa Verified status through the backend
verified creator posts are prioritized in the public feed
two-year account tenure receives automatic Bishwa verification
verification congratulations appear on the next app entry
description: Verifies only the signed-in Bishwa owner can award a verified badge with BS and that the verified status is persisted and announced to the member.
setup: The owner account is signed in as biswassuprotik3@mail.com
A separate member account exists with a saved Bishwa profile
steps: Open Profile and search for the member
Choose DS and verify the member remains unverified
Choose RSS and verify the member remains unverified
Choose BS and verify the member receives Bishwa Verified status
Sign in as the member on a separate session and reopen Bishwa
expected: Only the owner account can access the controls; DS and RSS do not award a badge, BS awards it, and the member sees the Bishwa Team verification congratulations on the next app entry.

name: Verify Bishwa Special as the official Bishwa channel
covers: backend checks the signed-in Bishwa owner identity
exact Bishwa Special channel is marked Bishwa Verified
official channel badge appears in public channel directory and detail page
blue B✔️ mark appears beside every verified channel post in the home feed
blue B✔️ mark appears beside every verified post in creator dashboard and public channel posts
official channel posts receive verified feed priority
description: Verifies the Bishwa owner can mark the unique Bishwa Special channel as the official verified channel and that the badge is visible throughout public discovery.
setup: A public active channel named Bishwa Special exists
The owner account is signed in as biswassuprotik3@mail.com
steps: Open Public Channels as the Bishwa owner
Choose Verify Bishwa Special as official
Verify the server confirms the channel and the verified badge appears beside its name
Return Home and verify every Bishwa Special post shows a blue B✔️ beside the channel name
Open My Channel and verify B✔️ appears beside each published post title
Open the public Bishwa Special page and verify B✔️ appears beside each post title
expected: Only the owner account can verify the exact Bishwa Special channel; the blue B✔️ mark appears beside every post from that channel in the creator dashboard, public channel page and home feed, while its posts receive verified feed priority.

name: Open and play media from a public channel
covers: admin V control appears on public channel detail for the owner account
admin verification panel opens from public channel detail
tap photo opens full-screen media viewer
tap video opens playable video viewer
media viewer closes and returns to channel content
description: Verifies the owner can reach verification controls from a public channel page and visitors can open photos and play videos by tapping their media cards.
steps: Sign in as biswassuprotik3@mail.com and open a public channel detail page
Tap V and verify the Bishwa owner verification panel appears
Close the panel, then tap a published photo and verify it opens in the media viewer
Close the viewer, tap a published video and verify the video player opens
Press play and then close the viewer
expected: The owner sees V and can open the verification panel; photos open in a full-screen viewer and videos open in a playable player.
